name: Sisense MCP
description: Explore Sisense data models, run natural-language queries, and build charts and draft dashboards from Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor over Sisense's hosted MCP server.

skills.name: Data Model Discovery
skills.description: Lists the data models and sources you can access and returns their tables, columns, relationships, and formulas.

skills.name: Natural Language Queries
skills.description: Runs a natural-language query against a chosen Sisense data model, using your governed metrics and relationships.

skills.name: Chart Building
skills.description: Builds line, bar, pie, or area charts from a query result and changes their type, sorting, styling, and trend or forecast lines.

skills.name: Draft Dashboards
skills.description: Creates or opens a dashboard as a chat draft and adds widgets, plain-language filters, and an AI summary without saving to Sisense.

skills.name: Pulse Monitoring
skills.description: Lists Pulses and their run history and runs an existing Pulse on demand to check whether its alert condition is met.
